events.title: The Apple Security Update Review for September 2026
events.summary: Apple released a major security patch covering 273 unique CVEs across all macOS, iOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS and Xcode, marking a significant software update.
events.why_it_matters: Several patches have high CVSS scores (up to 9.8), indicating severe vulnerabilities that could impact users of Apple’s operating systems if they remain unpatched. The breadth of updates stresses the need for timely patching across a diverse ecosystem.
events.resolution: Apple resolved this critical security event with a September 2026 update covering 273 unique CVEs across macOS, iOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS and Xcode. It also released iOS/iPadOS 26.7.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and Sequoia 15.8.1 on 28 September to fix a CoreGraphics out-of-bounds write. CISA later added that flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after confirming active exploitation, and a public proof-of-concept was published. Affected Apple users should apply the available patches to stay protected.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-65400 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-08-18, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-08-21.
CVE-2026-84609 is rated 9.8 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by CISA in the CVE record, the highest of the 550 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-23918 being exploited in the next 30 days at 50%, the highest of the 550 CVEs here.

timeline.summary: Zero Day Initiative added CVE-2026-43716, CVE-2026-43746
First reported by Zero Day Initiative
Apple released iOS/iPadOS 26.7.1, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and Sequoia 15.8.1 on 28 September, fixing a CoreGraphics out-of-bounds write Apple said may have been exploited in targeted attacks.
CISA added an Apple CoreGraphics out-of-bounds write affecting iOS, iPadOS and macOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.
A public proof-of-concept exploit has been published for the Apple CoreGraphics zero-day patched in late September, giving attackers a ready-made reproduction of the flaw.
